honeycomb-yellow.$description: Honeycomb Yellow — Primary brand color, header band, primary action buttons, nav active state, link underline color, accent fills — the one chromatic note everything else orbits around

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, heavy borders, button outlines, icon strokes, nav text — the structural ink of the entire system

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Secondary text, body copy, button borders, input borders — a slightly warmer near-black for softer reading

pearl-gray.$description: Pearl Gray — Page canvas, product card backgrounds, the cool stage on which yellow and black perform

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Muted badge surfaces, secondary chip backgrounds, low-emphasis UI fills

smoke-line.$description: Smoke Line — Hairline dividers, subtle table/card separators

times-now.$description: Display and heading serif — used for hero headlines, product names, and section titles. The ultralight 100 weight at 47px creates a tall, almost compressed editorial feel; the condensed letterforms (lineHeight 0.87–0.90) let large headlines sit close to their supporting copy, mimicking a printed poster.

times.$description: Body copy serif — an unexpected choice for e-commerce that gives the whole site a literary, catalog-like voice. The tight 1.15 line-height keeps paragraph blocks compact and readable.

helvetica-neue.$description: Small UI labels, button text, micro-copy — set in 11px with generous letter-spacing (0.0730em) to create an all-caps editorial feel even at body temperature

helvetica.$description: Navigation, links, utility text, large numbers — the utility sans that handles everything Times can't. Letter-spacing of 0.0630–0.0910em on small sizes gives all-caps nav items a wide, confident gait.
